subject: FinCo migration: OpenAI-compat eval & hyperscaler comparison
messages:
From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood migration / OpenAI-compat eval

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — that was helpful. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope an internal POC: 

- Goals: confirm Redwood can be a drop-in replacement for our existing OpenAI-based stack (same API surface, minimal SDK changes), verify prompt fidelity and hallucination profile for our finance prompts, and compare latency/cost vs our current hyperscaler endpoints (AWS Bedrock + Azure OpenAI).
- Constraints: data residency (US-only), SOC2 evidence, and procurement timelines (we need vendor paperwork by end of month).

Next steps we discussed: you to share a migration checklist and a short SDK snippet for the OpenAI-compat endpoint; we will provide a set of 50 seed prompts and sample responses to run a prompt-diff. Also would like a quick perf baseline (100 concurrent users, 1k tokens average) versus Bedrock and Azure.

Can you send the playbook and a test account/API key we can use for the POC? Also loop in your security contact for the SOC2 questions so I can get the compliance packet to procurement.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Perez
Lead ML Engineer, FinCo
alex.perez@finco.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@finco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood migration / OpenAI-compat eval

Alex — thanks for the clear recap, and great meeting. TL;DR: we can support an OpenAI-compatible flow + migration playbook, we'll spin up a POC project, and we can run the perf/cost baselines you requested.

Action items (from Redwood):
1) Share migration playbook and SDK snippets (attached: redwood-migration-playbook.pdf). The playbook covers our OpenAI-compatible REST endpoints, cURL and SDK swaps, and common prompt-diff pitfalls we see during migrations.
2) Create a POC project and short-lived API key for your team (I'll follow up with the key via secure stub).
3) Run baseline throughput/latency/cost tests for the three variants you mentioned (Redwood hosted, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) — need to confirm the exact models and sequence lengths.
4) Loop in security — David will send SOC2 and data residency documentation.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (7/15): share playbook and ask for your seed prompt set and target model variants.
- 7/16: we create the POC project and deliver an API key + SDK snippet.
- 7/17-7/20: run the prompt-diff and perf baselines; deliver comparison report by 7/22.

Sample SDK swap (OpenAI-compat):
- cURL: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REPLACE_KEY>" https://api.redwood.run/v1/completions -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"..."}'
- Node: replace openai endpoint and key; our SDK exposes the same methods and payload shapes.

Attachments: redwood-migration-playbook.pdf (playbook), plus I'll upload a short checklist to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/finco/migration-playbook

I'll send the API key via secure channel once you confirm the email addresses to grant. CC'ing Dylan (perf lead) and David (security) so they can own the baseline tests and compliance packet.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood migration / OpenAI-compat eval

Marissa — thanks. Sending over the seed prompts and a short CSV with expected categories attached (FinCo_test_prompts.csv). A couple of clarifications: 

- Model variants: for parity we want to test your gpt-4o-mini equivalent, plus the same generation params we use on Azure OpenAI (max_tokens=512, temp=0.2). For Bedrock we use an instruction-following Anthropic variant — we'll include the exact model ids in the sheet.
- Compliance: procurement needs the SOC2 cert and our legal team will need the data processing addendum. David, please send the security packet to procurement@finco.com.

Also, can you confirm if Redwood's streaming responses map 1:1 to OpenAI's streaming events (i.e., do you send delta tokens and a final event)? That matters for our front-end integration.

Thanks — attaching prompts now.

Best,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@finco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood migration / OpenAI-compat eval

Alex — we created the POC project and added the email(s) you listed. Quick status: 

- API key delivery: sent secure stub redwood-api-key.txt (we will rotate after the POC). Use the key with the OpenAI-compatible endpoint shown in the playbook.
- Streaming: yes — our streaming events are OpenAI-compatible: delta token events plus a final "done" event. We document edge-cases in the playbook.
- Perf tests: Dylan will start the baseline runs today. To be explicit about the compare matrix, can you confirm the exact model ids for Bedrock + Azure so we can run apples-to-apples tests (same prompt set, same generation params)?

Next meeting: if you'd like, book a 30-min slot here: https://calendly.com/marissa-30min — we can review initial diffs and the first perf runs on 7/20.

Attached: redwood-migration-playbook.pdf (again), FinCo_test_prompts.csv (the file you sent, mirrored), redwood-api-key.txt (API key stub).

If procurement needs SOC2 and DPA, David will send the package to procurement@finco.com within the hour.

Looking forward — Marissa
